# Tim Moore - Cinematography Portfolio

> > Professional cinematography portfolio showcasing Tim Moore's work as a director of photography across narrative films, documentaries, and performance videos.

Tim Moore is a cinematographer and director of photography whose portfolio features work on diverse projects including short films like Aerial Avery, Still Life, Run Time, Triage, and Penny & Claude, documentary work such as Wasioja Civil War Days, performance videos for West African All-Stars, and commercial work for clients like Hertz and Wolters Kluwer.
